dialogues.jp:
お見舞いに柑橘系の果物を買ってきた。酸っぱ
いものを食べれば元気になるかなと思ったのだ。
dialogues.en:
I bought a basket of citrus fruits to visit her with. Maybe
if she ate something sour, she'd cheer up as well.
dialogues.text:
I bought a basket of citrus fruits to visit her with. Maybe
if she ate something sour, she'd cheer up as well.

dialogues.jp: たとえそれが気休めだと思っていても。
dialogues.en: It could serve as something soothing.
dialogues.text: It could serve as something soothing.

dialogues.jp:
少しでも、ことりに元気になって欲しかったの
だ。
dialogues.en: I just wanted Kotori to be a little happier...
dialogues.text: I just wanted Kotori to be a little happier...

dialogues.jp: 俺はことりが好きだから。

ことりの家の前に立つ。ぐっと腹に気合いを入
れ、インターホンを押した。
dialogues.en:
I stood in front of Kotori's house. Taking a deep breath, I
pressed the interphone button.
dialogues.text:
I stood in front of Kotori's house. Taking a deep breath, I
pressed the interphone button.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、[name]だけど」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「その……お見舞いに来たんだけど」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことり？」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『そ、その……ごめん』

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
『その……今、ひどい顔をしてるの。だから
　……』
語尾がうやむやに途切れる。
dialogues.en: Her voice trailed off at the end.
dialogues.text: Her voice trailed off at the end.

dialogues.jp:
顔を見合わせてなくて良かった。落胆がはっき
りと出てるだろうから。
dialogues.en:
I was almost glad that I didn't have to see Kotori's face...
it would probably discourage me.
dialogues.text:
I was almost glad that I didn't have to see Kotori's face...
it would probably discourage me.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『ごめんね……』

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いや、いいんだ」

インターホン越しのやりとりは、どこか寒々し
いものがあった。電話じゃない。会話のための
機械じゃないのだ。
dialogues.en:
I could practically feel the desolation on the other side of
the interphone. This wasn't made for people to have
conversations.
dialogues.text:
I could practically feel the desolation on the other side of
the interphone. This wasn't made for people to have
conversations.

dialogues.jp: 「えっと、明日、どうする？」
dialogues.en: "Erm, about tomorrow, is it still on?"
dialogues.text: "Erm, about tomorrow, is it still on?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「体調悪いんだったら、明後日にする？　俺は、
　それでもいいけど」
dialogues.en:
"If you're not feeling well, then shall we make it the day
after tomorrow? I'm fine with either."
dialogues.text:
"If you're not feeling well, then shall we make it the day
after tomorrow? I'm fine with either."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『う……ひっく……うう……』

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ことり？　どうしたんだよ？　……泣いてる
　のか？」

インターホンに顔を近づける。少しでも、こと
りを感じられるように……。
dialogues.en:
I brought my face closer to the interphone. Futilely trying
to feel her closer...
dialogues.text:
I brought my face closer to the interphone. Futilely trying
to feel her closer...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
『ううっ……ぐすん……ゆ、遊園地……行きた
　いね……ひっく』
dialogues.en:
"Uuu... sniff... I want to go... to the amusement park...
hic..."
dialogues.text:
"Uuu... sniff... I want to go... to the amusement park...
hic..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ちょ……ちょっと、ことり、どうしたんだよ？
　行きたいねって……行くに決まってるだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"W... wait, Kotori, what's wrong? You want to go... then why
don't we?"
dialogues.text:
"W... wait, Kotori, what's wrong? You want to go... then why
don't we?"

dialogues.jp: つい、声が荒くなってしまう。
dialogues.en: My voice was hurried and confused.
dialogues.text: My voice was hurried and confused.

dialogues.jp: 「体調なんて、すぐに良くなるよ」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『う、うん……そうだね』

鼻をぐすぐす言わせながら、インターホンから
そんな言葉が届いてきた。
dialogues.en:
Along with the words, I could hear her rubbing her nose over
the interphone.
dialogues.text:
Along with the words, I could hear her rubbing her nose over
the interphone.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『大丈夫……きっと、大丈夫……』

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
『明日になったら、私は……前の私に戻ってる
　から……』
dialogues.en: "Tomorrow, I'll... I'll go back to my old self..."
dialogues.text: "Tomorrow, I'll... I'll go back to my old self..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『それじゃ……切るね』

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あっ」
ガチャ。
前の私って……一体どういうことだ？
dialogues.en: Her old self... what's that supposed to mean?
dialogues.text: Her old self... what's that supposed to mean?

dialogues.jp: わけが分からなかった。
こんなインターホンで話しててもダメだ。
dialogues.en: This interphone was no good for talking.
dialogues.text: This interphone was no good for talking.

dialogues.jp:
こんなに側にいるのに、ことりを感じることが
できないなんて意味がない。
dialogues.en:
Something that doesn't let me feel like I'm beside Kotori
has no reason to exist as a communcation device.
dialogues.text:
Something that doesn't let me feel like I'm beside Kotori
has no reason to exist as a communcation device.

dialogues.jp: 俺はインターホンを｛にら／睨｝みつけ──。
「うおぉぉぉぉっ！」

インターホンのボタンを連打する。すぐに、こ
とりが出た。
dialogues.en:
I pushed the interphone button like a madman, until Kotori
finally picked it up again.
dialogues.text:
I pushed the interphone button like a madman, until Kotori
finally picked it up again.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『……どうしたの？』

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「こ、ことり、よーく聞いてくれ！」

インターホンなんか使わなくても聞こえるくら
い大きな声で。
dialogues.en:
My voice went up several decibels, although I knew I didn't
need to for her to be able to hear me.
dialogues.text:
My voice went up several decibels, although I knew I didn't
need to for her to be able to hear me.

dialogues.jp: 「俺はだな！」
つまり、ご近所に筒抜けということで。
dialogues.en: My voice could be heard throughout the neighbourhood.
dialogues.text: My voice could be heard throughout the neighbourhood.

dialogues.jp: 「ことりが！」
今さらながら顔が熱くなってくる。
dialogues.en: My face was starting to redden.
dialogues.text: My face was starting to redden.

dialogues.jp: だが、かまうもんかっ！
dialogues.en: But I can't be stopped now!
dialogues.text: But I can't be stopped now!

dialogues.jp: 「ことりが大好きだぁっ！」
言い切った。

心臓がバクバク言ってる。気を抜いたら、今に
も倒れてしまいそうだった。
dialogues.en:
I had just shouted what my heart felt I should. I collapsed
next to the interphone.
dialogues.text:
I had just shouted what my heart felt I should. I collapsed
next to the interphone.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『ぷっ、くすくす……』

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことり？」
屈託のない笑い声。久しぶりに耳にした。
dialogues.en:
A carefree laugh. It's been a long time since I heard that
from Kotori.
dialogues.text:
A carefree laugh. It's been a long time since I heard that
from Kotori.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『急になにを言い出すのかと思った』

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『近所の人にまで聞こえちゃったよ』
dialogues.en: "Everyone in the neighbourhood could hear you."
dialogues.text: "Everyone in the neighbourhood could hear you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ご、ごめん」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
『近所迷惑だって怒られたら、朝倉君のせいだ
　からね？』
dialogues.en:
"If the neighbours complain about it, it'd be your fault,
no?"
dialogues.text:
"If the neighbours complain about it, it'd be your fault,
no?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「その時は代わりに謝っておいてくれ」
dialogues.en:
"When that happens, please apologize to them on my
behalf..."
dialogues.text:
"When that happens, please apologize to them on my
behalf..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『うん、わかったよ』

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「明日、遊園地に行こうな」
dialogues.en: "Let's go to the amusement park tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "Let's go to the amusement park tomorrow."

dialogues.jp:
永遠に続くかと思った沈黙は、しかし小さな吐
息とともに終わりを告げる。
dialogues.en:
There was nothing but silence for what seemed like an
eternity. Finally, her whispering voice strained out.
dialogues.text:
There was nothing but silence for what seemed like an
eternity. Finally, her whispering voice strained out.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『…………それじゃ』
ガチャ。
答えはなかった。

けど、俺の気持ちはしっかりと伝えたし。最後
には少し、ことりの声に元気が戻ったような気
がする。
dialogues.en:
But I was finally able to tell her my feelings. I felt that
I had made her a little more cheerful, somehow.
dialogues.text:
But I was finally able to tell her my feelings. I felt that
I had made her a little more cheerful, somehow.

dialogues.jp:
これで問題がすっかり解決したとは思えなかっ
たけど……。
dialogues.en: But even then, it doesn't settle the big problem...
dialogues.text: But even then, it doesn't settle the big problem...

dialogues.jp:
白河家を仰ぎ見る。あの内側で、ことりは何を
考えているのだろう？
dialogues.en:
I looked up at the Shirakawa residence. Kotori is inside...
what is she thinking?
dialogues.text:
I looked up at the Shirakawa residence. Kotori is inside...
what is she thinking?

dialogues.jp:
（夢見る能力があれば、分かったかもしれない
　のに……）
dialogues.en:
"(If I still had my dream-seeing powers, I could probably
find out...)"
dialogues.text:
"(If I still had my dream-seeing powers, I could probably
find out...)"

dialogues.jp: 「いや……あんなのは所詮、不自然だしな」
dialogues.en: "No... in the end, that's not natural."
dialogues.text: "No... in the end, that's not natural."

dialogues.jp:
あんな能力に頼らなくたって、俺はことりの恋
人だし、これからだってそのつもりだ。
dialogues.en:
I shouldn't be relying on things like that to be a good
boyfriend to Kotori.
dialogues.text:
I shouldn't be relying on things like that to be a good
boyfriend to Kotori.

dialogues.jp: ぐっと気合いを入れて、家路につく。
dialogues.en: Feeling charged up, I started heading home.
dialogues.text: Feeling charged up, I started heading home.

dialogues.jp: 明日は楽しい一日にしよう。絶対に！
dialogues.en: Tomorrow will be a great day, definitely!
dialogues.text: Tomorrow will be a great day, definitely!

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりの苦しみ◆
お見舞いに行くが、ことりは顔を見せなかった。
dialogues.en: I tried to visit Kotori, but couldn't even see her face.
dialogues.text: I tried to visit Kotori, but couldn't even see her face.

dialogues.jp:
だが、俺はことりが好きだと伝え、ことりにそ
の気持ちは届いたと信じたい……。
dialogues.en:
Yet, I believe that my feelings of love for her were able to
reach her...
dialogues.text:
Yet, I believe that my feelings of love for her were able to
reach her...
